format: raw SRAM, 3036 bytes (0x0000-0x0BDB, the part the game writes), each 32-bit word reversed as Project64 and Mupen64Plus store .sra; the length (cut after the last written byte) is Project64's

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/n64-dexdrive.py convert super-smash-bros.18976.n64 OUT --raw sram-swapped: raw SRAM, 3036 bytes, words already reversed, padded with FF to 32 KiB

converted_standalone.how: the same bytes as the .srm regions, as standalone Mupen64Plus keeps them: <GoodName (32 chars)>-<MD5 8>.eep/.sra/.fla/.mpk in its save folder

note: Posted as a DexDrive save; it is a raw emulator .sra. The word order is Mupen64Plus/Project64's and the file ends after the last byte the game writes (0xBDB), which is how Project64 1.x writes SRAM; the converter pads it with FF to 32 KiB.
